comment: ANCHOR: WATCHLIST_NEWS_ENRICHMENT_LQ2137_20261111 — /api/v2/watchlist reads news_articles.relevance_score (quality_score does not exist), and a failed enrichment read (news, social, scan, llm_health) is reported as enrichment_unknown with its reason and stamps the item UNKNOWN, never as no data.
